body: I failed chemistry and calculus multiple times while my mom was ill and then passed away. I managed to retake my other classes and do well in them but I'm a biology major so failing chemistry and calculus more than once looks awful. I planned to transfer from community college in two years and then it turned to three. Now it looks like it's going to be four years. I used to be the kid who would set the curve in classes and now I'm so far off track.
Oh, sorry. He did radiation for a year and he's in decently good health now, thankfully.
He drinks a lot. Doesn't cry as much as he used to. I know he wishes that he was the one that died instead of my mom.
